title: Surprise-Gated Memory for Live Speaker Diarization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20819v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We transpose the Surprise-Gated Memory recipe, a frozen encoder plus a calibrated novelty signal that gates a one-shot episodic store consolidated by periodic replay, from continual visual learning to live speaker diarization. The moment-to-moment question a streaming diarizer must answer, whether an arriving voice belongs to an already-heard speaker or a new one, is a known-versus-novel decision, exactly the decision the surprise gate is built for. On a frozen fine-tuned DiariZen backbone, our online system SGM-Diar recovers 4.8 of the 9.2 diarization-error points separating a naive online baseline from the offline oracle on AMI-SDM (52%) and 1.9 of 2.3 points on VoxConverse (82%), in the end-of-meeting revisable mode, with calibration frozen on development data and transferred cross-domain without adjustment. translated_title: 面向实时说话人分离的惊奇门控记忆
translated_abstract: 我们将“惊奇门控记忆”（Surprise-Gated Memory）方案——即一个冻结的编码器加上一个经过校准的新颖性信号，该信号用于门控一个由周期性重放进行巩固的单次情景记忆存储——从持续视觉学习迁移到实时说话人分离任务。流式说话人分离系统需要随时回答的核心问题是：新到达的声音属于已经听过的说话人，还是一个全新的说话人。这本质上是一个“已知还是新异”的判断，而惊奇门控正是为此而设计的。在一个冻结的微调DiariZen骨干网络上，我们的在线系统SGM-Diar在会议结束可修订模式下，在AMI-SDM数据集上恢复了朴素在线基线与离线最优结果之间9.2个说话人分离错误点中的4.8个（52%），在VoxConverse上恢复了2.3个点中的1.9个（82%），且校准参数在开发数据上冻结后可直接跨域迁移而无需调整。这些结果是在三个AMI会议和五个VoxConverse会话上的单种子运行所得。
tldr: 该论文将惊奇门控记忆机制（冻结编码器加新颖性信号门控情景记忆、周期重放巩固）从持续视觉学习迁移到实时说话人分离，SGM-Diar系统大幅缩小了在线基线与离线最优结果的差距（AMI-SDM上恢复52%错误差距、VoxConverse上恢复82%），且校准无需调整即可跨域迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper transposes the Surprise-Gated Memory recipe (a frozen encoder plus a calibrated novelty signal gating a replay-consolidated episodic store) from continual visual learning to live speaker diarization, where SGM-Diar closes 52% of the online-vs-offline error gap on AMI-SDM and 82% on VoxConverse, with calibration transferred cross-domain without adjustment.
